title: Tenant-bound API key lookup response
description: API-key and entitlement lookup MUST row-lock the matching key in a serializable transaction before evaluating active, revocation, expiry, or current-scope state. Expiry MUST be evaluated with a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock after the lock and rechecked after response validation immediately before COMMIT; unknown, inactive, concurrently revoked, expired, or invalid-scope keys MUST fail closed without disclosure. Entitlement lookup MUST also row-lock the resolved organization entitlement before response validation.

organization_id.description: Every persisted organization_id resolved from an API key or entitlement MUST be a non-empty, at-most-255-character, exact NFC-normalized Unicode-scalar string without surrounding whitespace, Unicode C0/C1 control characters, Unicode line or paragraph separators, Unicode format or bidirectional controls, Unicode noncharacter code points, or Unicode private-use code points. Malformed or noncanonical persisted organization identifiers MUST fail closed immediately after the API-key row lock and before key activity evaluation, entitlement access, response emission, or COMMIT; providers MUST NOT normalize, trim, sanitize, coerce, or disclose them.

name.description: Every persisted API-key name returned by active-key lookup MUST remain a non-empty NFC-normalized Unicode-scalar string without surrounding whitespace, Unicode C0/C1 control characters, Unicode line or paragraph separators, Unicode format or bidirectional controls, Unicode noncharacter code points, or Unicode private-use code points. Malformed or noncanonical persisted names MUST fail closed after the key row lock and before response emission or COMMIT; providers MUST NOT normalize, trim, sanitize, or disclose them.

items.description: Every configured, requested, and persisted identity scope MUST be a non-empty Unicode-scalar string already in exact NFKC normalization and MUST NOT contain Unicode White_Space property characters, Unicode C0/C1 control characters, Unicode General Category Cf format controls, Unicode noncharacter code points, Unicode private-use code points, Unicode variation selectors, Unicode default-ignorable code points, or Unicode combining marks. Canonically or compatibility-equivalent alternate spellings, whitespace-bearing values, control-bearing values, format-control-bearing values, noncharacter-bearing values, private-use-bearing values, variation-selector-bearing values, default-ignorable-bearing values, and combining-mark-bearing values MUST fail closed before identity verification, entitlement evaluation, API-key creation, response emission, or persistence access; providers MUST NOT normalize, trim, or sanitize caller, configuration, or persisted scope values.

scopes.description: An active API key response MUST contain a non-empty unique scope list that remains a subset of the provider's current allowlist; empty, malformed, duplicate, or retired scopes MUST fail closed and MUST NOT resolve as an active key.
